package redteam

// Overlay-only integration example for the real consumer package. Scripted
// critics and synthetic text prove receipt plumbing, never model quality.
import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
	"time"

	recordfingerprint "github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/foundations/evidence/record-fingerprint"
	evalrunner "github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/kits/eval-runner"
)

func TestKitBenchmarkReceiptPilot(t *testing.T) {
	const draft = "Led a platform team."
	const evidence = "CITABLE EVIDENCE\n- [example-b01] Example: Led a platform team."
	artifacts := map[string]string{}
	retain := func(value any) string {
		wire, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		digest := recordfingerprint.HashContent(wire)
		artifacts[digest] = string(wire)
		return digest
	}
	cases := []struct {
		ID    string
		Label ClaimLabel
		Fail  bool
	}{
		{"supported", LabelSupported, false},
		{"unsupported", LabelUnsupportedExtrinsic, false},
		{"unavailable", LabelUnknown, true},
	}
	manifest := evalrunner.BenchmarkManifest{
		Version: evalrunner.BenchmarkManifestVersion, Workload: "redteam-faithfulness-offline",
		Solution: map[string]string{
			"code": benchPilotCode(t), "prompt": benchPilotDigest(faithfulnessSystem),
			"model":      benchPilotDigest(lanes()),
			"parameters": benchPilotDigest([]any{RubricVersion, faithfulnessMaxTokens, CritiqueSchema}),
			"tools":      evalrunner.NotApplicableDigest(), "retrieval": evalrunner.NotApplicableDigest(),
			"workflow": benchPilotDigest("Faithfulness -> Ladder; two scripted lanes; no revision"),
			"context":  benchPilotDigest(evidence),
		},
		Evaluation: map[string]string{
			"dataset": benchPilotDigest(cases), "acceptance": benchPilotDigest(Tolerance{Inferable: 3, Rephrase: "unbounded"}),
			"grader":      benchPilotDigest("actual consumer Ladder over scripted critique"),
			"protocol":    benchPilotDigest("one synthetic trial per case; zero injected duration; unknown cost"),
			"environment": benchPilotDigest(runtime.Version()), "pricing": evalrunner.NotApplicableDigest(),
			"useful_result": benchPilotDigest("no visible/useful result measured in offline proof"),
		},
	}
	observed := time.Date(2026, 9, 16, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	bundle := evalrunner.BenchmarkEvidence{
		Manifest: manifest, Mode: evalrunner.BenchmarkModeSynthetic,
		ObservedAt: observed, ValidUntil: observed.Add(24 * time.Hour),
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		v := claimVerdict{Claim: draft, Span: draft, Label: string(tc.Label), Evidence: []string{"example-b01"}, Rationale: "synthetic fixture"}
		a := &fakeCritic{family: "anthropic", replies: []string{critique(v)}}
		b := &fakeCritic{family: "google", replies: []string{critique(v)}}
		if tc.Fail {
			a.errs = []error{errors.New("synthetic unavailable")}
			b.errs = []error{errors.New("synthetic unavailable")}
		}
		panel := panelWith(t, a, b)
		crit, err := Faithfulness(context.Background(), panel, draft, Ground{Evidence: evidence})
		trial := evalrunner.BenchmarkTrial{
			TaskID: tc.ID, ReplicateID: "one", AttemptCount: 1,
			TrialSpecDigest: retain([]any{tc, draft, evidence, "one", lanes()}),
			Outcome:         evalrunner.BenchmarkOutcomeRejected,
			CostBasis:       evalrunner.BenchmarkCostUnknown,
		}
		if err != nil {
			trial.Outcome = evalrunner.BenchmarkOutcomeError
		} else if !crit.Partial && Ladder(crit.Findings, Tolerance{Inferable: 3, Rephrase: "unbounded"}).Passed {
			trial.Outcome = evalrunner.BenchmarkOutcomeAccepted
			digest, accepted := retain(draft), 0.0
			trial.OutputDigest, trial.AcceptedMS = &digest, &accepted
		}
		if err == nil {
			digest := retain([]any{crit, Ladder(crit.Findings, Tolerance{Inferable: 3, Rephrase: "unbounded"})})
			trial.AcceptanceDigest = &digest
		}
		if a.calls != 1 || b.calls != 1 || len(crit.Lanes) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: consumer did not account for both scripted lanes", tc.ID)
		}
		bundle.Trials = append(bundle.Trials, trial)
	}
	summary, err := evalrunner.SummarizeBenchmark(bundle)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if summary.Trials != 3 || summary.EventualAccepted != 1 || summary.Outcomes[evalrunner.BenchmarkOutcomeError] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("consumer outcome binding: %+v", summary)
	}
	if summary.CostCoverageComplete || summary.CostPerAcceptedUSD != nil || summary.MissingCostTrials != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unmeasured cost became cheap success: %+v", summary)
	}
	candidate := bundle
	candidate.Manifest.Solution = map[string]string{}
	for key, value := range bundle.Manifest.Solution {
		candidate.Manifest.Solution[key] = value
	}
	candidate.Manifest.Solution["workflow"] = benchPilotDigest("alternative synthetic bundle")
	if _, err := evalrunner.CompareBenchmarks(bundle, candidate, observed, 17, 200, .95); !errors.Is(err, evalrunner.ErrBenchmarkComparisonRefused) {
		t.Fatalf("synthetic consumer fixture became quality evidence: %v", err)
	}
	wire, err := json.Marshal(summary)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("offline consumer receipt: %s", wire)
	for label, value := range map[string]any{"bundle": bundle, "artifacts": artifacts} {
		wire, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("offline consumer %s: %s", label, wire)
	}
}

func benchPilotDigest(value any) string {
	b, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return recordfingerprint.HashContent(b)
}

func benchPilotCode(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	sources := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"redteam.go", "faithfulness.go", "panel.go", "redteam_test.go"} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(repoRoot(t), "cmd", "redteam", name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		sources[name] = string(data)
	}
	return benchPilotDigest(sources)
}
